# ex: implicit & in non-selector context (applySubst implicit op outside selector)
ex {
	var p *T
	p.X -> F(p)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(p *T) int { return p.X }

func G(t T) int {
	return t.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@
 func F(p *T) int { return p.X }

 func G(t T) int {
-	return t.X
+	return F(&t)
 }
